secrets.name: MP_ACCESS_TOKEN
secrets.description: MercadoPago access token (Chile) — enables the online checkout. Optional: without it the cart falls back to a WhatsApp message for coordinating payment.

secrets.name: BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN
secrets.description: Vercel Blob read/write token — lets the admin panel upload product images. Optional: the storefront renders its bundled images without it.
